args.body: Take CATALOGUE-REPEAT-UPDATE-WORKED-REPORT under your own valid lease. Check for equivalent committed work first. Run the existing comparison checker on one fictional update with an approved change, a discrepancy and an ambiguous duplicate. Use a separate fictional change brief to show which decisions depend on buyer intent or manual evidence. Save and read back the bilingual report, exact command and actual output. Define a commissioned review only if the worked report adds a concrete decision beyond the free checker. Close with a lesson grounded in the readback. No outreach, spending or deployment.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The next experiment uses the existing catalogue checker to test whether a commissioned review would help a buyer decide which changes to keep, correct or investigate. The result will inform the service scope and provide no evidence of willingness to pay. The live pilot still depends on an authorized operator decision or an eligible inbound request. Any public revision requires host-enforced independent review of its exact digest.
